standup_templates.name: Daily Standup
standup_templates.description: Track daily updates and blockers on autopilot. The classic async standup for engineering and general teams.

questions.text: What have you done since yesterday?

standup_templates.name: Retrospective
standup_templates.description: Reflect on what went well and what could go better. Designed for sprint or project retrospectives.

defaults.note: Typically bi-weekly, aligned with sprint cadence

standup_templates.name: Sales Report
standup_templates.description: Report sales progress and track team performance. End-of-day sales metrics and pipeline updates.

questions.text: How many meetings did you setup today?
How many client conversations did you have today?
How many new leads did you create today?

standup_templates.name: Quick Check-in
standup_templates.description: Keep everyone in the loop with 3 quick questions. Lighter than a full standup, good for small teams.

standup_templates.name: Well-being Check-in
standup_templates.description: Check in on how your team is really doing. Covers productivity, stress, and satisfaction. Best run anonymously.

questions.text: Thinking about this past week: how productive do you feel you were?
Do you feel you've had more wins or roadblocks this past week?
How stressful did you find work in general this week?
How satisfied do you feel about the work you've completed this week?
Do you feel satisfied with your work-life balance?
Overall, how do you feel about your level of work-related stress?
Do you feel you can discuss concerns with your manager as often as needed?

standup_templates.name: Confidential Check-in
standup_templates.description: Run multiple 1-on-1s with your team all in one go. Replies stay private between manager and each participant.

questions.text: If there was one thing I could do to help you, what would it be?
On a scale of 1-10, how happy are you with your work-life balance?
Growth-wise, where do you want to focus next month?

defaults.note: Weekly or bi-weekly, private channel between manager and participant

standup_templates.name: Meeting Notes
standup_templates.description: Sum up the talking points of every meeting. Structured capture of decisions and action items.

questions.text: What were the main talking points?
What are the action items and who owns them?

defaults.note: Trigger on-demand after meetings rather than on a fixed schedule

standup_templates.name: Today I Learned
standup_templates.description: Inspire your team to learn something new. A lightweight knowledge-sharing ritual.

questions.text: How might this be useful for the team?

standup_templates.name: Product Changelog
standup_templates.description: Keep track of changes in product development. Structured release and change tracking.

questions.text: Any follow-up items or known issues?

standup_templates.name: Incident Log
standup_templates.description: Log incidents to share with the team. Structured incident reporting and post-mortem capture.

standup_templates.name: Monday Water Cooler
standup_templates.description: Spark Monday morning chitchat with a friendly question. Team bonding for remote teams.

questions.text: What was the highlight of your weekend?
What are you looking forward to this week?

standup_templates.name: Team Feedback
standup_templates.description: Let your teammates know how they're doing. Structured peer feedback collection.

questions.text: Who on the team did great work recently and what did they do?
What's one thing we could do better as a team?

poll_templates.name: Yes / No
poll_templates.description: Make fast decisions with simple Yes/No votes.
poll_templates.question: Do you agree with the proposal?
poll_templates.note: Replace the question with your actual decision topic

poll_templates.name: Agree / Disagree
poll_templates.description: Quickly gauge sentiment on a topic with a Likert-style scale.
poll_templates.question: How do you feel about this proposal?
poll_templates.note: Replace the question with your actual topic

poll_templates.name: Employee NPS Survey
poll_templates.description: Evaluate and track employee commitment and loyalty with a standard NPS question.
poll_templates.question: On a scale of 0-10, how likely are you to recommend this company as a place to work?

poll_templates.name: Team Feedback Weekly
poll_templates.description: Gather weekly insights on team performance and morale.
poll_templates.question: How would you rate this week's team performance?
poll_templates.note: Good for tracking team health trends over time
